Engage NOC engineers on incidents to see the incident through to successful resolution. Work as part of a global team that provides 24x7 IP Desk coverage on a rotation basis. Qualifications TCP/IP, VPN,MPLS and routing knowledge (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, RIP, IS-IS). Hands-on experience with the configuration of Cisco, Arista and Juniper routers and switches.
